'''2004 Oklahoma State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 24 July 2004 at the All Star Sports Complex, 10309 East 61st Street, Tulsa, Oklahoma, with [[Guy Kargl]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-3537-48346">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48346#48346 2004 Oklahoma State Championship -- July 24, 2004], Guy Kargl (Freelancer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021342/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51176%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Registration began at 11:00 AM and play at noon; entry was $10, with no cash prize, and Kargl estimated attendance at 15 players.<ref name="pcf-3537-48346" />

Kargl requested the [[Players Committee]]'s "Ultimate Package" prize support and asked players to pre-register to help raise the $125 it cost.<ref name="pcf-3537-48346" /> The package arrived the week before the event; its grand prize was the chance to design a virtual card. A few days before the event only five players had said they would come.<ref name="pcf-3537-50605">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50605#50605 2004 Oklahoma State Championship -- July 24, 2004], Guy Kargl (Freelancer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (21 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021342/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51176%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]], the Dantooine Flight Leader, had three players definitely coming from Texas.<ref name="pcf-3537-48893">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=48893#48893 2004 Oklahoma State Championship -- July 24, 2004], Michael Richards (mr007agent), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021342/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51176%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Kargl posted the results on a separate website, okstates.brettonwoodshoa.com.<ref name="pcf-3537-51176">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51176#51176 2004 Oklahoma State Championship -- July 24, 2004], Guy Kargl (Freelancer), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (25 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021342/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51176%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Site:''' All Star Sports Complex, 10309 East 61st Street, Tulsa, Oklahoma<ref name="pcf-3537-48346" />

* '''Time:''' registration 11:00 AM; play from noon<ref name="pcf-3537-48346" />

* '''Tournament director:''' [[Guy Kargl]]<ref name="pcf-3537-48346" />
